title: message.waiting
description: A message reached one of the org's numbers while no app held the agent it routes to — the process between two deploys, a gateway just restarted. It is kept here, on the agent's own log, and answered the moment a socket holds the agent again; message.taken says when. One older than WhatsApp's customer-service window is never answered.

MessageWaiting.description: One message, kept until somebody can answer it.

env.description: The world the number answers in.

number.description: The org's number it was written to, E.164.

phone_number_id.description: The provider's id for that number: what the answer is sent from.

from.description: Who wrote it: the provider's id for the person.

name.description: The name the provider shows for them, when it shows one.

message_id.description: The provider's id for the message: what message.taken names.
